algorithm: Layered merge: defaults < ini string < environment < CLI, with typed coercion

classes.desc: Layered configuration with typed coercion, per-key source tracking, and validation.
classes.name: Config

data_flow_ascii:
SCHEMA defaults -> load_defaults
SAMPLE_INI string -> load_ini (layer 2)
PREFIX_* env vars -> load_env (layer 3)
--set key=value -> set (layer 4)
resolved table + sources -> validate -> printed report
description_sentence: A layered configuration manager that merges defaults, an INI snippet, environment variables, and CLI overrides with type checking and validation.
failure_note: Unknown keys, bad INI lines, and uncoercible values raise ValueError with the offending line or key named; validate() collects range problems.

functions.desc: Convert a raw string to kind; raises ValueError on bad input.
functions.name: coerce

functions.desc: Layer 2: parse flat key = value lines from an INI-style string.
functions.name: Config.load_ini

functions.desc: Layer 3: PREFIX_KEY environment variables, e.g. DEMOAPP_PORT.
functions.name: Config.load_env

functions.desc: Layer 4: a single CLI override in key=value form.
functions.name: Config.set
functions.signature: set(self, key: str, raw: str) -> None

functions.desc: All resolved values as a plain dict.
functions.name: Config.as_dict

functions.desc: Return a list of human-readable problems; empty means valid.
functions.name: Config.validate

functions.desc: Resolve all four layers, print the table, and validate.
functions.name: run_demo
functions.signature: run_demo(seed: int, cli_overrides: list, env_prefix: str) -> int

functions.desc: Build the command-line parser for the demo.
functions.name: build_parser

functions.desc: Parse flags and run the config demo.
functions.name: main

label: config manager
output_shape: Prints a resolved-config table (key, value, type, source layer, description) plus the validation verdict.
pitch_sentence: I built a {topic} that merges defaults, files, environment, and CLI flags into one validated configuration with full provenance.

qa.a: Later layers win: defaults, then the INI snippet, then PREFIX_* environment variables, then --set overrides.
Every set records its layer in _sources, so the demo prints exactly where each value came from.
qa.q: How do you know where a value came from?

qa.a: Booleans accept true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off case-insensitively; anything else raises ValueError.

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} in Python with four-layer precedence, typed coercion, per-key source tracking, and schema validation.
run_notes: --set key=value is repeatable for CLI overrides; --env-prefix changes the environment variable prefix.
scaling_note: Flat key/value schema suits service config; deeply nested configs would want a tree model instead.
storage_note: In-memory only: the demo plants one process-local env var and keeps nothing on disk.
tradeoff_note: Flat keys keep merging rules obvious; nested sections would complicate precedence and validation.
